🆕 NEW RELEASE: Spike and Me First and the Gimme Gimmes release Shit the Bed

Spike and the Gimme Gimmes and Me First and the Gimme Gimmes have teamed up for the covers album Shit the Bed, out since 23 October 2026 via Fat Wreck Chords. The 11 tracks include It's Raining Men, Hey Ya!, I Want It That Way and We Are the World.

🎟️ TOUR NEWS: Dead By April and Memphis May Fire announce 2027 tour

Dead By April and Memphis May Fire co-headline an EU and UK tour from 30 April to 28 May 2027, with Seven Blood as special guest. Nine of the 22 dates are in Germany, starting in Berlin on 5 May and ending in Cologne on 22 May.

📣 JUST ANNOUNCED: Simple Plan and Bad Religion join Graspop 2027

Simple Plan and Bad Religion are among the new acts confirmed for Graspop Metal Meeting 2027 in Dessel, Belgium, which runs from 17 to 20 June. Pierce The Veil, Millencolin and Silverstein are part of the same announcement.
